title: Inventory & Order Management System
tagline: Customized e-commerce inventory and order fulfillment platform integrated with Shopify and Shiprocket.
overview: A customized inventory management platform that connects Shopify and Shiprocket to automate order processing, warehouse management, employee assignments, invoice generation, and shipping operations.
role: Full Stack Developer (Architecture, Webhooks, API Integrations, Database Schema)
highlights: Shopify Webhook Integration: Automated real-time order intake, inventory syncing, and order status updates without polling delays
Warehouse and Rack Management: Bin-level mapping, stock movement tracking, and physical inventory allocation across warehouse locations
Employee-wise Order Assignment: Automated and manual task delegation for warehouse staff with role-based status workflows
Mobile Order Processing: Streamlined picking, packing, and validation interface optimized for mobile and handheld warehouse scanners
Automated Invoice Generation: Programmatic generation of compliant PDF invoices, packing slips, and order receipts
Shipping Management: Direct Shiprocket API integration for real-time courier rate comparison, AWB label generation, and live dispatch tracking

title: WhatsApp Flow Automation Platform
tagline: Low-code platform empowering businesses to create, manage, and deploy interactive WhatsApp Flows.
overview: A visual drag-and-drop platform empowering businesses to build interactive multi-screen WhatsApp Flows for WhatsApp Business Accounts with real-time phone preview and automatic schema validation.
highlights: Drag-and-drop flow building canvas with reusable UI components (Heading, Text Body, Conditions, Rich Text, Input Fields)
Automated Flow JSON generation via custom adapters with a single-click build action
Interactive real-time mobile simulator previewing flows on an emulated smartphone screen before deployment
Strict client-side validation preventing WhatsApp Business API configuration errors prior to deployment

title: Chatbot Analytics Dashboard
tagline: High-visibility conversational analytics dashboard monitoring user journeys and conversion funnels.
overview: Built to monitor user journeys across chatbot touchpoints. Captures milestone events throughout conversations, tracks drop-off stages, and delivers real-time statistical insights so businesses can maximize conversion rates.
highlights: Tracked granular user journeys with milestone checkpoints across conversational sequences
Real-time funnel metrics identifying high-friction drop-offs and overall completion velocity
High-throughput event ingestion backed by efficient MongoDB aggregation pipelines
Actionable business intelligence metrics empowering customer support and sales teams

title: High-Scale Data Migration Pipeline (AWS to Data Center)
tagline: Zero-downtime, fault-tolerant batch migration pipeline moving 100,000+ sensitive documents.
overview: Resilient batch migration pipeline engineered to safely transition 50,000 to 100,000+ sensitive documents from AWS cloud storage to on-premise data centers during infrastructure modernization with zero data loss and zero downtime.
highlights: Automated URL substitution and validation replacing AWS S3 URLs with data-center endpoints
Pre- and post-migration verification counting affected documents to ensure 100% data integrity
Stateful tracking of completed vs. pending documents with pause, audit, and resume capabilities
Chunk-based asynchronous batch processing eliminating database locks and downtime

title: WhatsApp In-Chat Payment Gateway Integration
tagline: Frictionless in-chat transaction integration utilizing WhatsApp Business API and payment providers.
overview: Engineered secure end-to-end payment workflow directly inside WhatsApp chats, enabling users to browse, select products, and complete payments without redirecting to external websites.
highlights: Implemented secure webhook handlers with cryptographic signature verification
Automated transaction receipts and instant order confirmation via WhatsApp messages
Maintained 100% payment API uptime and idempotent transaction handling

title: AI Knowledge Base & RAG Vector Search (Exploration)
tagline: Retrieval-Augmented Generation prototype using vector databases and LLM embeddings.
overview: Exploration of grounding LLMs using vector similarity search. Ingests domain documents, generates dense embeddings, and stores them in Qdrant for semantic search and context injection into LLM prompts.
highlights: Document chunking and dense vector embedding generation
Semantic similarity search using Qdrant vector database
Prompt construction with strict context boundaries to eliminate hallucinations
